remarks:
Your Next Masterpiece Begins Here. Hidden among the trees on 6.11 private acres, this beautifully renovated contemporary home offers the rare opportunity to live in what feels like a modern four-story treehouse. Designed to embrace its natural surroundings, the home is filled with dramatic windows, soaring views of the forest, and an abundance of natural light that pours into every level, creating an atmosphere that is both inspiring and peaceful.  

With over 2,300 square feet, 4 levels of living space, 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and thoughtful updates throughout, every floor offers its own unique experience. Multiple living areas provide endless flexibility for an artist studio, writer’s retreat, home office, music room, fitness space, or guest accommodations. The finished fourth floor has been transformed into additional living space, offering a private escape limited only by your imagination.  

Whether you’re entertaining friends, working remotely, or simply unwinding after a long day, every room is designed to connect you with nature. Expansive windows frame the changing seasons like living artwork, while the covered porch invites morning coffee, evening conversations, and quiet moments beneath the trees. A detached two-car garage provides additional storage, workshop potential, or space for outdoor recreation equipment.  

Conveniently located near Ellicottville, Holiday Valley, HoliMont, Allegany State Park, and the Southern Tier, this exceptional property is ideal as a luxury country home, vacation retreat, weekend escape, Airbnb investment, or full-time residence.

More than just a house, this is a destination you’ll look forward to coming home to every single day—a place where the outside world fades away, creativity flourishes, and every season becomes part of the experience.

Private. Renovated. Light-filled. One of a kind. Welcome home.
